result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the bottom navigation is broken by a thick black bar obscuring the central icons.

issues.description: Bottom navigation bar is overlapped by a thick black horizontal bar that obscures the middle icons (search and saved). Icons are barely visible underneath the bar and the bar sits inside the navigation area instead of below it.
issues.suggestion: Move the system home indicator below the navigation bar, restore its normal thin style, and add proper bottom padding so all navigation icons are fully visible and tappable
